name: Imouto Anal ~Koi Suru H na Pink no Tsubomi~
original_name: 妹アナル ～恋するＨなピンクのつぼみ～
source: The protagonist, Utou Shuuichi, has been living alone in the countryside when he's visited by his sister Chizuru, whom he has been separated from for 8 years, along with his cousin Suwana. They came to take care of him, but Chizuru actually has a huge crush on him and wants to confess her feelings. While Shuuichi was happy if troubled by his persistent sisters, he knew that he can't have a physical relationship with them, so he comes up with a certain plan to deal with the situation: anal sex.
translation: 主人公宇藤秀一一直独自生活在乡下，此时，与他失散八年的妹妹千鹤和表弟诹访来拜访了他。他们是来照顾他的，但千鹤实际上非常喜欢他，并想坦白自己的感情。虽然修一很高兴被他执着的姐妹们困扰，但他知道他不能与她们发生身体关系，所以他想出了一个特定的计划来处理这种情况：肛交。
